evidence: The growth conditions for the binary oxides NiO and TiO2 were selected on the basis of previous work combined with own optimizations. The adopted pulsing and purging parameters for the NiO process were: 2 s Ni(acac)2 pulse, 1.5 s purge, 3 s O3 pulse, 3 s purge. ... The films were grown in an F-120 Sat reactor (ASM Microchemistry Ltd.)
